macros.name: basepageboxwidth
macros.doc: The width of the box with the base page is \basepageboxwidth.

macros.name: commentscolskip
macros.doc: The length \commentscolskip is the distance between comment columns.

macros.name: commentscolwidth
macros.doc: The length \commentscolwidth is the width of the comment columns.

macros.name: commentsflushbottom
macros.doc: The commands \commentsraggedbottom and \commentsflushbottom produce either columns of comments with no stretchability, or with aligned last lines.

macros.name: commentsraggedbottom
macros.doc: The commands \commentsraggedbottom and \commentsflushbottom produce either columns of comments with no stretchability, or with aligned last lines.

envs.name: commeditText
envs.doc: Normal pages in the commented edition are set up with the environment commeditText.
